strings.zh: 你们现在的小孩,{NEWLINE}买东西都是想白漂的吗？{CLEAR}真是太没有教养了。{SCROLL}总之你不给钱,{NEWLINE}休想拿走我的鲤鱼王！
strings.en: Kids these days, always wanting{NEWLINE}stuff for free? No manners at all.{SCROLL}Anyway, no money, no Magikarp!

strings.zh: 呜……我明明很想买鲤鱼王的。
strings.en: *sniff*... I really wanted{NEWLINE}to buy that Magikarp.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『哪里有什么{NEWLINE}会产黄金的鲤鱼王,{CLEAR}你分明就是在骗人吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: There’s no such thing{NEWLINE}as a Magikarp that lays gold.{CLEAR}You’re obviously a con man!

strings.zh: 你这人怎么说话呢！{NEWLINE}我卖的东西可都是货真价实！{CLEAR}你可不要……
strings.en: How dare you talk like that!{NEWLINE}Everything I sell is the{CLEAR}genuine article! Don’t you...

strings.zh: 啊！你是在圣安努号上救了我的恩人！{NEWLINE}真没想到还能在这遇见你。
strings.en: Ah! You’re the one who saved{NEWLINE}me on the S.S. Anne! I never{CLEAR}thought I’d run into you here.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『既然你也在圣安努号上{NEWLINE}吃过火箭队的苦头,{CLEAR}那你就将心比心{CLEAR}不要再用骗术伤害别人了好吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You suffered at Team Rocket’s{NEWLINE}hands on the S.S. Anne too. So put{CLEAR}yourself in others’ shoes, and stop{CLEAR}hurting people with your scams, OK?

strings.zh: 恩人你可不能这么说,{NEWLINE}我的鲤鱼王真的产过黄金。{CLEAR}不过既然恩人不让卖了,{CLEAR}那我就不卖了,{CLEAR}我自己留着致富就是。
strings.en: You can’t say that, my savior.{NEWLINE}My Magikarp really did lay gold.{SCROLL}But since you won’t let me sell it, I{NEWLINE}won’t. I’ll keep it and get rich myself.

strings.zh: 这个是我们家鲤鱼王的特产,{NEWLINE}就当是报答你的救命之恩,{CLEAR}送给你吧。
strings.en: This is a specialty of my Magikarp.{NEWLINE}Take it as thanks for saving my life.

strings.zh: 有一天早上我发现{NEWLINE}在我养殖鲤鱼王的水池里{CLEAR}出现了一颗金珠。{CLEAR}我断定那就是鲤鱼王产的卵,{CLEAR}我那一池的鲤鱼王中,{CLEAR}肯定有能产黄金的鲤鱼王！
strings.en: One morning I found a Nugget in the{NEWLINE}pond where I raise my Magikarp.{SCROLL}I’m sure it’s a Magikarp egg.{NEWLINE}Somewhere in my pond full of Magikarp,{CLEAR}there has to be one that lays gold!

strings.zh: 我的大嘴鸥经常会从海上{NEWLINE}叼一些树果回来。{CLEAR}你如果想要的话,我可以卖你一点。
strings.en: My Pelipper often brings back{NEWLINE}Berries from the sea. If you{CLEAR}want some, I can sell you a few.

strings.en: Sitrus Berry{NEWLINE}1 for $1000

strings.zh: 想买的话随时再来找我。
strings.en: If you want to buy some,{NEWLINE}come find me anytime.

strings.zh: 你带的钱不够啊。
strings.en: You don’t have enough money.

strings.zh: 这是你的树果,请拿好。
strings.en: Here are your Berries. Take them.

strings.zh: 无论是海上航行还是外出旅行,{NEWLINE}都需要即使补充维生素。{CLEAR}我们公司生产的PP果,{CLEAR}就是最好的维生素补品。{CLEAR}您看要不要买一点呢？
strings.en: Whether you’re sailing the{NEWLINE}seas or traveling the land, you{CLEAR}need to keep your vitamins up.{SCROLL}The Leppa Berries our{NEWLINE}company produces are the best vitamin{CLEAR}supplement there is. Care to buy some?
